command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP: create inventory-api app dir"
sudo -n mkdir -p /opt/inventory-api

echo "STEP: write inventory-api application"
sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-api/app.py > /dev/null <<'PYEOF'
import json
import threading
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

INVENTORY = [
    {"sku": "A100", "name": "Widget", "qty": 42},
    {"sku": "B200", "name": "Gadget", "qty": 17},
    {"sku": "C300", "name": "Gizmo", "qty": 8},
]

START = time.time()
REQUEST_COUNT = 0
LOCK = threading.Lock()

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _json(self, code, payload):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        global REQUEST_COUNT
        with LOCK:
            REQUEST_COUNT += 1
            count = REQUEST_COUNT
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._json(200, {"status": "ok", "uptime_s": round(time.time() - START, 1), "requests": count})
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            self._json(200, {"items": INVENTORY, "requests": count})
        else:
            self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
PYEOF

echo "STEP: write systemd unit with OOM protection"
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service > /dev/null <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-api/app.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
MemoryHigh=256M
MemoryMax=512M
User=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-api

sleep 1
echo "STEP: verify service active"
systemctl is-active inventory-api
